hr: Tor način: u postavkama sav promet može ići kroz Orbot, pa server ne vidi tvoju IP adresu
u Tor načinu nema DNS upita s mobitela ni povratka na izravnu vezu ako Orbot ne radi
prikaz veze u postavkama pokazuje radi li Orbot
en: Tor mode: settings can send all traffic through Orbot, so the server does not see your IP address
in Tor mode the phone makes no DNS lookups and never falls back to a direct connection if Orbot is down
the uplink line in settings shows whether Orbot is running
